inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.label: Label
inbox.noResults: No chat or message matches that search.

empty.all: No open chats. New WhatsApp messages land here.
empty.unanswered: Every customer message has a reply.
empty.flagged: No chat has gone unanswered past the limit.
empty.unassigned: Every open chat has someone on it.

inbox.showing: Showing {shown} of {total}. Search or filter to narrow it down.
inbox.noNumbersBody: Link a number with the official WhatsApp Cloud API or scan a QR with your WAHA or Evolution API gateway. Chats and groups show up here.
inbox.keysTicket: Ticket from the last customer message

thread.flaggedBanner: A customer message has waited longer than your limit.
thread.notePlaceholder: Only your team sees this note.
thread.replyPlaceholder: Write a message. Type / for quick replies.
thread.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
thread.ticketByReaction: Reaction sent. If it is the ticket emoji, the ticket is in Tickets.
thread.scheduleNeedsText: Write the message in the box first.

details.name: Name
details.renameLocal: This number uses the official API: the new name only changes here.
details.crmSearch: Link a CRM company or contact
details.crmHelp: The latest messages and open tickets show up on the CRM record.
details.agentNone: Create an agent in Agents to answer here.
details.agentHelp: The agent answers new messages from this number with its knowledge and tools. If it hands off, the chat waits for your team.
details.groupsUnsupported: This number uses the official API, which does not manage groups here. Use a WAHA or Evolution API number for groups.
details.notAdded: WhatsApp did not let us add {phones}. Send them the invite link.
details.inviteHelp: Some people block being added to groups. The link always works.
details.inviteRevoked: Link reset. The old one stops working.
details.removeBody: Its messages, notes and labels are deleted here. The chat or group stays in WhatsApp, and a new message brings it back.

list.title: Groups
list.desc: Every WhatsApp group of your numbers, with members, labels and properties.
list.noNumbersBody: Connect a WhatsApp number to create and manage groups.
list.needsBridge: Creating groups and managing members needs a number connected with WAHA or Evolution API. The official API covers 1:1 chats.
list.selected: {n, plural, one {# group selected} other {# groups selected}}
list.emptyBody: Create one here, import many from a CSV, or bring in the groups your number already has from Settings.
list.participantsHelp: Phones with country code. People who block being added get the invite link instead.

csv.title: Create groups from a CSV
csv.help: Columns: name, participants (phones separated by spaces or ;), description, admins. Up to 50 groups at a time.
csv.preview: {n, plural, one {# group ready to create} other {# groups ready to create}}
csv.create: Create {n, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}

title.add: Add members to {n, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}
title.remove: Remove members from {n, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}
title.promote: Make admins in {n, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}
title.demote: Remove admins in {n, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}

bulk.addHelp: Adding many strangers fast can get a number restricted by WhatsApp. Prefer the invite link for new people.
bulk.help: Phones with country code, separated by commas or lines.

tickets.desc: Tickets from WhatsApp messages: by hand, by reacting with {emoji} or by keyword. Each one has a due time from your SLA.
tickets.title: Title
tickets.emptyBody: Create one from a message in the inbox, or react with the ticket emoji from the app or the phone.

broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.desc: Send one message to many groups and chats, now or later, at a pace that protects your number.
broadcasts.newDesc: Pick the groups and chats, write the message and choose when it goes out.
broadcasts.emptyBody: Send updates to all your customer groups at once, or schedule a message for later.
broadcasts.name: Name (only for you)
broadcasts.perMinuteHelp: {minutes, plural, one {Under a minute for everyone.} other {About # min for everyone.}} Slower is safer for the number.
broadcasts.previewEmpty: Write the message to see the preview.
broadcasts.sendNow: Send to {n, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}
broadcasts.schedule: Schedule for {n, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}
broadcasts.risk: Messages go out one by one at the pace you set. A number that sends a lot of unrequested messages can be restricted by WhatsApp.
broadcasts.noChats: No chats for this number and filter.
broadcasts.cancelTitle: Cancel the rest of this broadcast?
broadcasts.cancelBody: {n} messages that have not gone out yet are cancelled. What was sent stays sent.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.desc: Volume, first response and tickets, by person and by group.
analytics.emptyBody: Metrics show up once messages come in and your team replies.
analytics.volumeAria: {inbound} received and {outbound} sent in the period
analytics.noAgents: Nobody has replied from Groups in this period.
analytics.note: First response counts replies from Groups, from the phone and from agents. Broadcasts do not count.
analytics.emptyFilteredBody: Try other dates, another label or all groups.

settings.title: Groups settings
settings.desc: Numbers, labels, quick replies, properties and ticket rules.

numbers.intro: Each number is a WhatsApp line your team answers from. Credentials are stored encrypted and are not shown again.
numbers.synced: {n, plural, one {# group synced} other {# groups synced}}
numbers.deleteBody: Its chats, groups, messages and tickets are deleted from Groups. Nothing changes in WhatsApp.
numbers.bridgeRisk: This mode uses an unofficial WhatsApp Web session through your own gateway. WhatsApp can restrict a number used this way. It is the mode that manages groups. For 1:1 messaging we recommend the official API.
numbers.cloudLimits: Official WhatsApp Cloud API: 1:1 chats, media and approved templates. It does not create groups or manage members here.
numbers.name: Name
numbers.keepSecret: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
numbers.cloudHelp: In Meta for Developers, open your app, WhatsApp, API setup. Copy the phone number ID and a permanent token. The app secret is in App settings, Basic.
numbers.wahaHelp: WAHA runs on your server (Docker image devlikeapro/waha). Use its URL and the WHATSAPP_API_KEY you set.
numbers.evolutionHelp: Evolution API runs on your server. Use its URL and the global or instance API key.
numbers.connected: Connected {phone}. New messages land in the inbox.
numbers.qr2: Go to Settings, Linked devices, Link a device.
numbers.qr3: Scan this code. This screen updates by itself.
numbers.webhookCloud: Paste it in your Meta app (WhatsApp, Configuration) with the same verify token, and subscribe to messages.
numbers.webhookBridge: We registered it in your gateway when connecting. It carries a secret: do not share it.

cloud.name: WhatsApp Cloud API (official)
cloud.desc: Meta's API. Best for 1:1 support and templates.

waha.name: WAHA (QR)
waha.desc: Self-hosted gateway. Groups, members, admins and invite links.

evolution.name: Evolution API (QR)
evolution.desc: Self-hosted gateway. Groups, members, admins and invite links.

fake.name: Demo number
fake.desc: A test number that never talks to WhatsApp. Only in demo and test setups.

labels.intro: Labels sort chats and groups. Filter by them in the inbox and use them to pick broadcast recipients.
labels.name: Label name
labels.deleteBody: It comes off every chat. The chats stay.

quick.intro: Type / and the shortcut in the composer to insert the text.

props.intro: Your own fields for chats and groups (plan, account owner, renewal date). They show in the details panel and work as broadcast variables.
props.label: Property name

rules.intro: When a chat counts as unanswered, what creates a ticket and how long each priority has.
rules.emojiHelp: Reacting with it to a message, from Groups or from the phone, creates a ticket. Empty turns it off.
rules.keywordsHelp: A customer message with one of these words creates a ticket. Comma separated.
rules.unanswered: Mark as overdue after (minutes without reply)

api.intro: Read chats, send messages and create tickets from your own systems with the public API.
api.scopes: Create a key with the groups:read and groups:write scopes in
api.webhooks: Outgoing webhooks and Flow triggers for these events:
api.flow: Flow can also send a WhatsApp message with the step Groups: send WhatsApp message.
api.docs: Every endpoint with examples is in
api.webhooksManage: Create endpoints, see the delivery log and resend from

crmBlock.title: WhatsApp
crmBlock.empty: No chat or group linked. Link one from its details panel in Groups.

errors.invalid_contact: That contact is not in your CRM.

errors.invalid_property: A property value does not match its type.

errors.polls_unsupported: Polls need a WAHA or Evolution number. The Meta Cloud API has no polls.

access.adminsOnly: Only workspace admins can change this.
access.labelsIntro: Turn it on and members only see the chats that carry one of their labels, plus the ones assigned to them. Admins see every chat.
access.labelAccess: Members see only chats with their labels
access.labelsNote: Applies to the inbox, search, Cmd+K, reports, exports, the API and the MCP server.
access.maskIntro: Numbers show as +54 ••• 00 for the roles you pick. The workspace owner always sees them.
access.maskNote: Also hidden in CSV exports, the API, the MCP server and push notifications. People with hidden numbers cannot remove or promote group members by phone.

audit.title: Activity
audit.intro: Who assigned, closed, labeled, exported or removed each chat, and who changed tickets and members.

integrations.webhooksIntro: We POST each event as JSON, signed with HMAC SHA-256 in the Zerosoft-Signature header. Failed deliveries retry 5 times (1 min to 12 h) and stay in the log.
integrations.disconnectBody: Credentials are deleted. Tickets already created there stay there.
integrations.keep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it

slack.name: Slack
slack.desc: Posts new tickets, ticket changes or incoming messages to a channel.
slack.help: In Slack, create an app with Incoming Webhooks, add it to the channel and paste the webhook URL here.

freshdesk.name: Freshdesk
freshdesk.desc: Each new ticket is created in Freshdesk too, and the status stays in sync both ways.
freshdesk.help: Your API key is in Freshdesk under Profile settings. The requester is the WhatsApp sender; for groups without a phone we use the fallback email.

zoho.name: Zoho Desk
zoho.desc: Each new ticket is created in Zoho Desk too, and the status stays in sync both ways.
zoho.help: Create a Self Client in the Zoho API Console with the Desk.tickets.ALL scope, generate a refresh token and paste it with the client id and secret. The org id and department id are in Zoho Desk settings.

integrations.zapier: Use a webhook below pointing to Webhooks by Zapier (Catch Hook) to start a Zap, and the API with an API key to act from a Zap.
integrations.mcpIntro: Connect Claude, Cursor or any MCP client over streamable HTTP. Tools: list chats, read messages, send messages and polls, assign and close chats, labels, and create, list and update tickets.
integrations.mcpTools: It acts as the person who created the API key (groups:read to read, groups:write to send and change). Create one in

apps.installIntro: Groups installs as an app on your phone and computer: its own icon and window, and notifications for chats assigned to you.
apps.howDesktop: Chrome or Edge on the computer: the install icon at the end of the address bar.
apps.howAndroid: Android: browser menu, then Install app.
apps.howIos: iPhone: Share in Safari, then Add to Home Screen. Notifications work from the installed app (iOS 16.4 or later).
apps.pushIntro: A notification when a chat assigned to you gets a message, or when someone assigns you a chat.
apps.pushDisabled: Push notifications are not configured on this server (VAPID keys).
apps.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
apps.denied: The browser blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the site settings.
apps.devices: {n, plural, =0 {no devices} one {# device} other {# devices}}

recurring.title: Recurring messages
recurring.cronHelp: minute hour day month weekday. 0 9 * * 1-5 is weekdays at 09:00.
recurring.dayOfMonthHelp: In shorter months it goes out on the last day.
recurring.endsAtHelp: Optional. Empty repeats until you pause it.
recurring.noNext: No upcoming runs with these settings.
recurring.create: {n, plural, one {Repeat to # chat} other {Repeat to # chats}}
recurring.empty: Nothing repeats yet: a weekly reminder or a monthly report to your groups goes here.
recurring.deleteBody: It stops repeating. Messages already sent stay in the chats.
recurring.detailDesc: Each run goes out with the same pace and per-number cap as broadcasts.
recurring.varsHelp: Variables such as the chat name or its properties use each chat data.

polls.title: New poll
polls.question: Question
polls.questionPlaceholder: Which day works for the call?
polls.voters: {n, plural, =0 {No votes yet} one {# person voted} other {# people voted}}
polls.unsupported: This number uses the Meta Cloud API, which has no polls. Send from a WAHA or Evolution number.
